metadata.title: Load Deploy Config
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Read .ai/deploy-config.json cd section, validate required fields (ado_project, cd.pipeline_definition_id, cd.target_environments), auto-discover from ADO if missing, and present to user for approval. Shares the deploy-config.json file with verify-ci-pipeline (which owns the ci section).

output.description: Resolved CD pipeline configuration ready for use by trigger-cd-pipeline

prerequisites: CI pipeline verification completed (verify-ci-pipeline step passed)
Git remote and CD pipeline configured for the repository

configSchema.description: Per-repo pipeline configuration. The cd section holds deployment/release settings consumed by the deploy-to-testing sub-process. The ci section is managed by verify-ci-pipeline.

structure.ado_project: ADO project name (e.g. 'Payoneer') — shared across CI and CD

cd.pipeline_definition_id: CD/release pipeline definition ID to trigger
cd.timeout_minutes: Max minutes to wait for pipeline completion (default: 20)
cd.source_branch: Source branch override (optional, defaults to current branch)

specificActions: Check if deployConfig already exists in memory from a previous CI step
Validate cd section: pipeline_definition_id and target_environments are required
Validate target_environments is an ordered array (e.g. ["QA"] or ["QA", "SB"])
If config missing or incomplete: auto-discover from ADO using mcp__azuredevops__pipelines_definition
Present resolved config to user for approval before proceeding
Store resolved config in memory as deployConfig (cd section)
Initialize or read cdRetryIteration from memory
tools: mcp__azuredevops__pipelines_definition - Auto-discover pipeline definitions for the repo
bestPractices: Always check memory first — the CI step may have already loaded the shared config
Only auto-discover if the config file is missing or has null required fields
When auto-discovering, present findings to user for confirmation before using them
Validate that target_environments is a non-empty array with valid environment names
The target_environments order controls deployment sequence — ["QA"] for QA only, ["QA", "SB"] for QA then sandbox
Distinguish between shared fields (ado_project) and cd-specific fields
If cdRetryIteration exists in memory, this is a retry — preserve existing config

substeps.name: Check Memory for Existing Config
substeps.description: Check if deployConfig already exists in memory from the CI step
actions: Read memory to check for existing deployConfig
If deployConfig exists with ado_project populated, note it for reuse
Check if cdRetryIteration exists — if so, this is a retry iteration

substeps.name: Read Deploy Config File
substeps.description: Read .ai/deploy-config.json and extract the cd section
actions: Check if .ai/deploy-config.json exists in the repo root
If exists: read and parse JSON, extract ado_project and cd.* fields
Merge with any existing deployConfig from memory (cd section may be new)

substeps.name: Validate CD Section
substeps.description: Ensure all required cd fields are present and valid
actions: Validate required fields: ado_project, cd.pipeline_definition_id, cd.target_environments
Validate target_environments is a non-empty ordered array
Validate environment names are recognized (e.g. QA, SB)
Apply defaults: timeout_minutes=20, poll_interval_seconds=30

substeps.name: Auto-Discover if Missing
substeps.description: Use ADO API to discover pipeline settings if config is incomplete
actions: Only execute if required fields are missing or null
Parse git remote for project and repo name
List pipeline definitions via mcp__azuredevops__pipelines_definition
Match CD/release pipelines by repo name and pipeline type
Prompt user for target_environments if not discoverable

substeps.name: Present Config for Approval
substeps.description: Show resolved config to user for confirmation
actions: Display the resolved CD config: pipeline ID, name, target environments, timeout, poll interval
Present to user for approval before proceeding
If user rejects, allow manual correction

substeps.name: Store Config in Memory
substeps.description: Persist resolved config and retry state to memory
actions: Store deployConfig with cd section in memory
Set cdRetryIteration (0 if first run, increment if retry)
Record config source (file vs auto-discovered) in memory

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
actions: Output: '✓ Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: Check memory for existing config → Read .ai/deploy-config.json → Validate cd section → Auto-discover if missing → Present to user for approval → Store in memory

memoryFileUsage.readFrom: CI step results (deployConfig with ado_project), .ai/deploy-config.json, previous CD retry iterations
memoryFileUsage.writeTo: Deploy config (cd section) and retry iteration state
fields: Information Produced: deployConfig (ado_project, cd.pipeline_definition_id, cd.pipeline_name, cd.target_environments, cd.timeout_minutes, cd.poll_interval_seconds, cd.source_branch), cdRetryIteration (current retry number)
Decisions Made: Config source (file vs auto-discovered vs memory), target environments validated
